# Anivora 0.1.33 — Reader navigation and owner console

- Fix next/previous chapter navigation after opening a downloaded manga chapter. The reader combines saved chapters with the provider's real chapter list, prefers saved pages from any provider by matching title/chapter number, and continues online for an unsaved next chapter. Downloaded chapters remain usable if the provider is unavailable.
- Fix next/previous episode selection from a downloaded anime episode. Download IDs now retain the correct anime/episode identity, the previous local file is detached on a switch, completed target downloads are preferred and undownloaded episodes resolve through the existing providers. Autoplay-next also applies to local playback when enabled.
- Improve WeebCentral/manga image requests with supported image-format negotiation and Android downsampling. Reload remounts images and bypasses stale image-cache results; errors distinguish HTTP, connection and decode failures without exposing signed URLs. A provider change remains available. Public provider availability on a particular phone still requires that phone's verification.
- Add a private, server-verified owner console on Cloudflare at `/admin/sign-in` for health, account growth, public comment leaders, measured watch/read activity, API traffic and Render bandwidth estimates. No public navigation exposes the console. Only the confirmed verified Google owner is allowed; runtime Render metrics require the Cloudflare Functions secret. Missing metrics are shown as unavailable.
- Add small bounded operational event batches and daily request rollups, with documented retention and an updated privacy policy. Counts begin with this version; older unmeasured activity is not invented. Account deletion removes linked events.
- Preserve the homepage/download/support route split, direct signed GitHub APK updates, horizontal remote avatar rows, original Google profile pictures, six bundled avatar fallbacks, on-device manga and server notices. Screenshot aspect ratios are corrected on the live website. Avatar, manga image and APK bytes do not pass through Render.

Android version code: **35**. Package: `com.brandon300.anivora`. ARM64, Android 7.0/API 24 or newer. Original signing certificate retained for installation over the existing app.

Validation includes TypeScript, lint, app/backend/site tests, Expo checks, browser layouts and secure owner-console fixtures, native unit/source/signature checks, and Android 14 emulator integration. The owner must configure the Google web origin and Cloudflare runtime Render secret if absent; both Render services were observed suspended for billing, so live backend analytics are unavailable until resolved. No physical Infinix Hot 50i certification or successful real owner Google login is claimed.

Source commit: https://github.com/brandon-300/Anivora/commit/0eb0b311ea08b49b70be48401165dec46ef99b0f
